meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先为一个界面定下明确的美学方向（如极简、杂志风、工业风等），再写出可直接运行的前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等），并按该方向打磨排版、配色、动效与布局，避开常见的 AI 味模板。
howto.when: 当你要构建网页、页面或应用组件，并希望设计有明确风格时触发。原文写明：受够千篇一律的 AI 味设计时就用它。

say.text: 用这个技能给我做一个作品集页面，走极简但有张力的风格
say.note: 它会先定美学方向再写代码

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 定价卡片组件，动效要有记忆点
say.note: 产出可运行的组件代码

say.text: 做一个深色杂志风落地页，别用 Inter 和紫色渐变
say.note: 字体配色会按你的要求挑

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first commits to a clear aesthetic direction (e.g. minimal, editorial, industrial), then writes running frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) and refines typography, color, motion and layout to match it, avoiding generic AI-style templates.
howto.when_en: Use it when you are building a web page, page or app component and want a design with a clear point of view. The description says to reach for it when you are tired of generic AI-looking design.

say_en.text: Use this skill to build me a portfolio page in a minimal but striking style
say_en.note: It sets the aesthetic direction before coding

say_en.text: Write a React pricing card component with memorable motion
Make a dark editorial landing page, no Inter, no purple gradients
say_en.note: Fonts and colors follow your brief
